Windows one-file release of VBA Add-in Editor. The ZIP contains `VBAAddinEditor.exe` and its SHA-256 checksum file.

## A new look

The editor has a new dark interface. The light theme is one click away under **View → Light Theme**. Saving, verification and backups work exactly as before; only the window changed.

- **Header instead of a menu bar.** File, Edit, Module, Ribbon, View and Help sit in a dark header bar. Alt+letter and F10 still open them. The header also shows the open file and how many changes are unsaved. **Save** is the one blue button, with **Review** and **Revert** beside it (previously "Save File", "Review Changes" and "Revert All").
- **Start screen.** With nothing open, the window offers **Open file…** and your recently opened files. They are also under **File → Open Recent**.
- **Syntax colouring** for VBA and ribbon/XML, plus a highlight on the current line. Only the lines on screen are coloured, so large modules stay as fast to type in as small ones.
- **Clearer module list.** ● marks an edited module, + a new one, → a renamed one, and 🔒 one that can't be renamed or deleted. Its code can still be edited, and selecting it says why it is locked. The "Object / Class / Form Code" group is now "Document Modules".
- **Tabs renamed** to **VBA code**, **Ribbon & XML** and **UserForms**.
- **Zoom** the code font with Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- (Ctrl+0 resets). Zoom and theme are remembered.
- **Status bar** shows line, column and file type.

## Fixes

- In a small window the status bar and warning banner could be pushed off-screen. In the **Compare External Changes** and **Ribbon Buttons** dialogs, the bottom row of buttons (including Apply/Cancel) could be hidden the same way. They now always stay visible.
- Line numbers now follow when you drag the scrollbar.

## Notes

- This is a development build, built and tested on GitHub's Windows runner. It has not been through the live Excel/PowerPoint qualification matrix.
- Message boxes (confirmations, errors) are still drawn by Windows in its light style.
- Known bug: a module whose code starts with a blank line fails save verification ("Body mismatch"). The original file is left untouched; remove the leading blank line and save again.
- Password-protected VBA projects remain read-only.
